title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on the iGPU alone vs split across the iGPU and an RTX 3080 Ti
setup: Temporary routers, same configuration (draft-mtp,ngram-mod, spec-draft-n-max 2, repeat-penalty 1.0, KV q8_0, flash-attn, batch 2048/ubatch 1024). iGPU alone: llama.cpp b11721 Vulkan build, device Vulkan0. Dual: llama.cpp b11721 CUDA+Vulkan build, devices Vulkan0,CUDA0 with tensor-split 80,20; the RTX was idle. Two passes, the second in reverse order; mean and (range).
conclusion: Splitting across the discrete GPU did not speed up this model: generation was ~20% slower (76 -> 61 tok/s) and prompt processing 10-18% slower (8K: -18%, 32K: -10%). The iGPU alone is faster and leaves the discrete GPU free for other work. The dual configuration is much more repeatable between passes (+-3%) than the iGPU alone (+-15-20%).
